Sorting a deck of cards by hand

Most programmers learn insertion sort from a textbook, but you can feel how it works with a deck of ordinary playing cards1. Hold the cards in your left hand and pick them up one at a time.

Each new card slides left past every larger card until it finds its place, which is why the method is quick on nearly sorted decks. 

function insertionSort(items) {
  for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) {
    const current = items[i];
    let j = i - 1;
    while (j >= 0 && items[j] > current) {
      items[j + 1] = items[j];
      j--;
    }
    items[j + 1] = current;
  }
  return items;
}

The function above mirrors the hand movement exactly. Notice that the variable current holds the card between your fingers while the loop shifts its neighbours2.

1 Any shuffled deck will do; jokers are optional.

2 Beginners often forget to restore the card after the loop ends.
